result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best accounting software for a small business depends on your business type, how many transactions you handle, and whether you want to manage the accounts yourself or use an accountant.

For a small business in the UK, I'd start by comparing **Xero, QuickBooks and FreeAgent**\. They're three of the strongest options for small-business bookkeeping, invoicing, expense tracking and tax management.

## Best accounting software compared

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall for growing businesses)

- Excellent bank reconciliation
- Invoicing and expense tracking
- VAT returns and HMRC integration
- Good accountant access and integrations

Best for limited companies and businesses planning to grow.

UK plans vary by features; check current pricing.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector | QuickBooks Logo Design – Financial Software Brand Identity – Intuit Accounting Tool – Green Book Icon - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/oPBKHlpW3VRRyCSbZmD52Nilt3jP5kEo8b4ANb2S-u8fQ6QePVB_cvAd6IKOks-js5QWUpymvIunIaun86-JlYhjPau-_Mhp346D7olgKRjyNS79MID_pjj6KHmiIVfhu-wdWRd3KzO8hLOPj0YW2TF6hrwN0i4exabp-2phx1LS7Y32gpTOZFzmWesJom6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks**

(Best for ease of use)

- User-friendly interface
- Good mobile app
- Automated bank feeds
- Invoicing, expenses and VAT

Best for owners who want to handle their own bookkeeping.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![FreeAgent Review: Features, Pricing, Pros & Cons](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AWrYG5UElICV_2QqNniGBOJg-DuJb7bzMDkMbcm700h1nQnWQTJ-0M80r1lnMU0oD2rFCgi2YvXIZB2Umi8wczyWPQfft3pogJ8F48-Lsaw-bXn26n8ROlYeIROX9k57q9T8hKC5ow8yJaZsxkoZIQjbRlS28cXXnAUhnN7Xx_NmwItPbM1G2HrfhOQcoZLf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreeAgent**

(Best for sole traders)

- Straightforward bookkeeping
- Self Assessment support
- Invoicing and expense tracking
- UK-focused tax features

Particularly attractive if you qualify for free access through an eligible bank account.

[FreeAgent website](https://www.freeagent.com/)

---

![Sage Group | Company Overview & News](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VFRaM7Mi6n-B6kypx5NEbH6uZ7gv6tyckO56Q4NaZ2LIxfSUsJX7-BpQgCEEs8eZ1yCTkoB51T4Vi6uho9n0Uh-lEm2VXgC1WYeJjEoJCLFmEjEBjRNPbTFFtsAcn4mH6vl8NHzKL61NACimMLcmOKip1T__uRJNPku-4fp2J-5qEQ-yptJXrboOZoUqd8Yu?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Sage**

- Strong UK accounting features
- Payroll options
- VAT and tax support
- Established accountant ecosystem

Best for businesses with employees and more traditional accounting needs.

[Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![Zoho Books Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4BiXY_WEN49lYCvbGaKDFfpQRd4AylQLrJUAqECUlizaJxfPoT7vHE_aMf89Ai5XDgiicM083l1mRaYjiwKVUSU-hyO3RMNhHn9n_1p9iDfGlD90vd7yixEZXe3uN-cFk5rC7bm4cnrvTfOD__DTiLg0FqR-qg85e1e4wDVsY_7IdvAZqwAqO3vtJfa4QIvd?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

- Good value for money
- Free entry-level option
- Invoicing and automation
- Integrates with other Zoho products

Best for smaller businesses looking to keep software costs down.

[Zoho Books website](https://www.zoho.com/uk/books/)

These recommendations reflect current UK comparisons, including 2026 reviews. ## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a typical small UK limited company, I'd start with **Xero**\.

If I were a sole trader or freelancer, I'd look at **FreeAgent** first.

If simplicity and ease of use were my priorities, I'd choose **QuickBooks**\.
